===== src/components/Button.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface ButtonProps {
  size?: "sm" | "lg";
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const VARIANTS: Record<string, string> = {
  "sm": "sm",
  "lg": "lg",
};
const VARIANT_CLASSES: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {
  "sm": { root: "py-2 px-3", label: "text-[14px]" },
  "lg": { root: "py-3 px-5", label: "text-[16px]" },
};

export function Button({ size = "sm", label = "Button", showIcon = true, className }: ButtonProps) {
  const variant = VARIANTS[size] ?? "sm";
  const v = VARIANT_CLASSES[variant] ?? {};
  return (
    <div className={cx("relative w-fit h-auto flex flex-row gap-2 items-center justify-start bg-[color:var(--color-brand,#4f46e5)] rounded-[8px]", v.root, className)} data-variant={variant}>
      {showIcon && <div className="relative w-2 flex-none h-2 min-w-0 min-h-0 bg-[#ffffff] rounded-[50%]" />}
      <p className={cx("relative w-fit flex-none h-auto min-w-0 min-h-0 [font-family:'Inter',sans-serif] font-semibold leading-[150%] text-left text-[#ffffff] whitespace-pre", v.label)}>{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
===== src/components/Card.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface CardProps {
  children?: ReactNode;
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function Card({ children, title = "Card title", className }: CardProps) {
  return (
    <article className={cx("relative w-80 h-auto flex flex-col gap-3 items-start justify-start p-4 bg-[color:var(--color-surface,#ffffff)] rounded-[12px] border-[1px] border-solid border-[#e4e4e7] shadow-[0px_4px_16px_-2px_#0000001f]", className)}>
      <h3 className="relative h-auto flex-none w-fit min-w-0 min-h-0 [font-family:'Inter',sans-serif] text-[20px] font-semibold leading-[150%] text-left text-[color:var(--color-text,#18181b)] whitespace-pre">{title}</h3>
      <div className="relative h-auto flex-none self-stretch min-w-0 min-h-0 flex flex-col gap-2 items-start justify-start">{children}</div>
    </article>
  );
}

===== src/cx.ts
/** Joins class names, skipping empty ones. */
export function cx(...names: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) {
  return names.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}
